text: The Patriots head into their Week 5 showdown against the Raiders significantly depleted in the secondary, ruled out for Sunday are starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck) alongside four other players, forcing the defense to operate without two key contributors in the back end. On the brighter side, running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice, offering some relief on the offensive side of the ball as New England prepares to face Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins, who has been one of the season's biggest surprises through the first four weeks. Beyond the injury concerns, the Patriots will celebrate Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction during Sunday's halftime ceremony, a moment of institutional pride amid what promises to be a competitive divisional test. The edge rusher combination of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas has been one of the defense's bright spots so far, and the Patriots will don throwback uniforms as they look to keep their season on track despite the secondary's significant absences.
